workflows.name: system-boundary-tracer
workflows.purpose: Returns a deterministic availability response from the independently deployable FastAPI boundary.

workflows.name: company-access-context
workflows.purpose: Returns the authenticated, policy-authorized selected company context through FastAPI.

technicalOwnership.statement: These tables implement operational control and event delivery only; they own no accounting, filing, billing, or authorization decision.

infrastructure.transactions: Short Postgres transactions owned by backend application workflows.
infrastructure.idempotency: Durable idempotency records are required for consequential commands before provider I/O.
infrastructure.eventDelivery: public.notification_outbox is the persisted event-delivery boundary.
infrastructure.migrationRunner: Supabase migrations in supabase/migrations are applied by the deployment migration runner.
infrastructure.durableWorker: A durable worker consumes persisted delivery state outside the initiating transaction.
